info.name: Picsart GenAI Ads Variable Data Content API

items.docs: Describes the Replay. Lists all variable data fields and their types: image, text, etc.

Export your Replays with async API in background to optimize for performance and improve your user experience.
Customize the output with your data. Here you can provide a CSV file with up to 50 rows and map your data to the variables in the Replay file. For each row in the data file, this service will export a file of the requested type.

info.name: Get the Export Variable Data Content result

params.name: transaction_id
params.description: The ID returned from the POST method.

items.docs: Use this method, along with transaction_id, to retrieve the export variable data content's finished results (e.g. list of PDF file URLs).
